response.sql: SELECT s.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.riskeval

assumptions.assumption: Rows with NULL gbsize or spanmin are excluded from the average. Rows with spanmin = 0 are also excluded to avoid division by zero. The average is the mean of per-scan ratios, not total gbsize divided by total spanmin.
Scans whose riskeval is NULL form their own group, shown with a NULL status.
